narrative.overview:
A white, airy page following the pinned references (adhamdannaway.com for the split face and soft cards, aaabadcode.com for the pastel fluid smoke). One oversized head, cropped below the collar, stands in the centre of a single scene: marketing on the left, development on the right. On desktop with a fine pointer, thin pastel smoke follows the cursor on the left and syntax-coloured code lights up under it on the right. On mobile (720px and below) there is no smoke and no code: two static washes, warm on the left and cool on the right, with a 1px divider tell the same split. Everything below the hero is quiet.

Colour is rationed: smoke or washes in the hero, brand-coloured glyphs in white chips, tiny pastel marks elsewhere. Depth comes from soft layered shadows and hairline rules. The page is static and light: Figtree self-hosted, no libraries, and smoke.js is imported only after load for fine pointers without reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, two pale bands (projects, contact), hairline dividers.
Single-scene hero: one transparent portrait, chips float beside it and never touch the body.
Mobile hero: no smoke or code, static warm and cool washes with a 1px divider and ringed chips.
Figtree variable for all human text; system mono only for code, repo names and the address.
White cards, 16px radius, two-layer soft shadows, lift on hover when linked.
Spanish copy with an English twin; nothing invented as proof.

rules.name: The Paint Rule
rules.body: Pastels live in the hero (smoke on desktop, washes on mobile). Elsewhere they are tiny marks only, never fills, buttons or card colours.

rules.name: The Borrowed Colour Rule
rules.body: Brand colours appear only inside tech chips, as glyph colour on white.

rules.name: The Cool Ink Rule
rules.body: Text is ink or muted; no pure black text, no warm greys.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Figtree for everything human-readable; mono only for literal code, repo names and the address.

rules.name: The Soft Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are layered, ink-tinted and low-opacity. No hard offset shadows, no coloured glows.

dos: Do keep pastel colour inside the hero (smoke on desktop, washes on mobile); keep brand colours inside white chips.
Do use ink and muted for text, line hairlines for structure.
Do give raised objects the Rest shadow; lift only linked cards, minis and contact cards.
Do build grids with minmax(min(Npx, 100%), 1fr) so a column never exceeds a narrow viewport.
Do use --sec-y (64px) as the vertical step between sections at 600px and below.
Do use cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) for transitions and honour prefers-reduced-motion and (pointer: fine) for heavy effects; load smoke.js only for fine pointers.
Do keep interactive targets at least 44px tall and the 3px blue focus ring visible.
Do keep copy in the half it belongs to.
Do separate fields with |, lists with commas and date ranges with a short hyphen and spaces.
donts: Don't fill buttons, cards or sections with the pastel accents.
Don't add dark themes or dark sections (the phone bezel inside a project card is a device frame, not a surface).
Don't use hard offset shadows, coloured glows or heavy borders.
Don't put controls, labels or chips on the face or the body.
Don't introduce a second text family or set prose in mono.
Don't show smoke or code in the mobile hero.
Don't invent proof (clients, metrics, testimonials) or link unlinked minis.
Don't use the middle dot as a separator in copy, titles or meta.
